pages.text: The flagship production line: the $(4)only source$(0) that refines Life Energy out of Akaishi Energy.$(br2)$(bold)Building it:$(0)$(li)Frame a $(4)3×3×3$(0) hollow sealed box with Life Conversion Matrix Casings$(li)Put an Energy Input Port and a Life Output Port into the walls$(li)Mount the controller $(4)on a wall$(0) — once the structure forms it runs itself; break any casing and it stops instantly$(br2)$(bold)Rates:$(0) up to $(4)45$(0) conversions per tick, each burning $(4)10M Akaishi Energy$(0) for $(4)10 Life Energy$(0) — about 450 Life/tick at full speed, demanding ~450M akaishi/tick. $(bold)Feed the grid first, then switch it on$(0).

$(bold)Energy Input Port$(0): a $(4)100M$(0) buffer that feeds the controller every tick, smoothing out the 10M gulps of each conversion.$(br2)$(bold)Life Output Port$(0): pulls up to $(4)450$(0) Life Energy per tick (at full output) into its own 5,000 buffer for Life Energy Pipes to drain.$(br2)Remember the pipe rule: $(bold)akaishi goes in, life comes out$(0) — don't swap them.

pages.title: About the Old Machines
pages.text: $(bold)Beware outdated blueprints$(0): the old $(4)Life Aggregation Converter$(0) and $(4)Life Conversion Architecture$(0) have $(bold)been replaced by the Matrix$(0). They are now just $(4)crafting materials$(0) with an energy buffer — they never run or form a structure on their own.$(br2)Fine as components, but if you expect them to refine life? $(bold)Build the Matrix$(0).
Storage and transport: "$(l:akaishi:life_energy)Life Energy$(/l)". The refined energy next becomes currency at the "$(l:akaishi:life_purifier)Life Energy Purifier$(/l)".
